title: Threads
subject: Operating Systems
subtitle: Paths of Execution Within a Process
guiding_question: How can a program perform multiple tasks at the same time?
description: A thread is a path of execution within a process. Threads share many process resources while maintaining their own execution contexts.

learning_objectives.text: Explain what a thread is and distinguish a thread from a program and a process.
Identify the resources shared by threads and the execution information maintained by each thread.
Explain thread states, scheduling, context switching, concurrency and parallelism.
Describe the advantages, limitations and synchronisation challenges of multithreading.
Relate threads to other operating-system concepts and practical applications.
